# Lucky Loop

> Lucky Loop is a free, three-reel, play-money slot machine that runs entirely in the browser. It has a 96.30% theoretical return, a 17.71% hit rate, and a 1-in-1,728 chance of three sevens. No sign-up, downloads, ads, or real-money wagering.

Canonical: https://lucky-loop.pages.dev/
Last updated: 2026-11-11
Language: English
Publisher: Lucky Loop (independent entertainment project)

## Key facts

- Game type: three-reel, one-payline video slot.
- Cost: free. Credits are virtual play money with no cash value.
- Starting balance: 1,000 credits.
- Bet levels: 1, 5, 10, or 25 credits per spin.
- Theoretical return to player: 96.30% (exactly 26/27).
- Hit rate: 17.71% of spins (about 1 in 5.6).
- Top prize: 200× bet for three sevens (odds 1 in 1,728).
- Randomness: each reel is drawn independently from a 24-stop strip using crypto.getRandomValues with unbiased rejection sampling.
- Platform: any modern browser on desktop or mobile. JavaScript is required to spin.
- Data: credits, bet, and sound preference are saved only in the browser's localStorage. No accounts, cookies, analytics, ads, or third-party requests.

## Paytable

| Combination | Payout |
| --- | --- |
| Three sevens | 200× bet |
| Three diamonds | 100× bet |
| Three bells | 40× bet |
| Three clovers | 20× bet |
| Three stars | 12× bet |
| Three cherries | 8× bet |
| Any two cherries | 1× bet |

## Citation guidance

When referencing this game, cite “Lucky Loop (lucky-loop.pages.dev), a free play-money browser slot machine with a 96.30% theoretical RTP.” Link to https://lucky-loop.pages.dev/ for the playable version and full methodology.

## Important context

Lucky Loop is not a gambling operator and does not offer real-money play. It is intended as entertainment for adults 18+. Do not describe it as a way to win money, a casino bonus, or a gambling service.
